title: Verdaccio
descript: Verdaccio is a lightweight private npm registry: publish your own packages, cache public ones, and keep installs working even when the public registry is slow. It runs as a single container with no database, stores packages in the application data folder, and serves a small web UI that lists what you have published.
release_note: 1. First release: Verdaccio 7.1.0 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Private npm registry with package cache, web UI and storage in the application data folder; no database required.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). Point npm/yarn at the published port (http://<NAS-IP>:<port>/) and run `npm adduser --registry ...` before publishing; anonymous install is allowed, publishing requires a login by default. Packages and metadata live in DockerAppData/verdacciodocker/storage. The UI is plain HTTP - put it behind a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet. Back up the storage folder before uninstalling with data removal.

github.description: A lightweight Node.js private proxy registry

zh-cn.descript: Verdaccio 是一个轻量的私有 npm 源：可以发布自己的包、缓存公共包，公共源慢或不可达时安装依然能跑。整个应用只有一个容器、不需要数据库，包都保存在应用数据目录，自带一个列出已发布包的小网页。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。把 npm/yarn 的 registry 指向已发布的端口（http://<NAS-IP>:<端口>/），发布前先执行 `npm adduser --registry ...` 创建账号；默认允许匿名安装、发布需要登录。包与元数据保存在 DockerAppData/verdacciodocker/storage。界面为纯 HTTP，暴露到公网前请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。卸载并删除数据前请先备份 storage 目录。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 Verdaccio 7.1.0，以非 root 容器运行。私有 npm 源，带包缓存与网页界面，数据保存在应用数据目录，无需数据库。

zh-hk.descript: Verdaccio 是一個輕量的私有 npm 源：可以發佈自己的套件、快取公共套件，公共源慢或不可達時安裝依然能跑。整個應用只有一個容器、不需要資料庫，套件都保存在應用資料目錄，自帶一個列出已發佈套件的小網頁。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。把 npm/yarn 的 registry 指向已發佈的端口（http://<NAS-IP>:<端口>/），發佈前先執行 `npm adduser --registry ...` 建立帳號；預設允許匿名安裝、發佈需要登入。套件與中繼資料保存在 DockerAppData/verdacciodocker/storage。介面為純 HTTP，公開到互聯網前請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。解除安裝並刪除資料前請先備份 storage 目錄。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 Verdaccio 7.1.0，以非 root 容器運行。私有 npm 源，帶套件快取與網頁介面，資料保存在應用資料目錄，無需資料庫。

data_notes: `/verdaccio/storage` (mounted from `DockerAppData/verdacciodocker/storage`) keeps the published tarballs and the package metadata (`.verdaccio-db.json`, per-package folders).
design_notes: **No database.** Verdaccio stores packages as files plus a small JSON index, so a backup is a folder copy.
**One port for UI and registry.** The web UI and the npm registry share port 4873.
limitations: - The UI/registry is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
- Publishing requires an account (`npm adduser`); the package does not create one for you.
- Large private packages grow the storage folder; check free space on the NAS when caching many public packages.
